description_en: Retrieves diff statistics for a merge request, including a file change tree, total added and deleted lines, and per-file line change statistics
description_zh: 查询合并请求的Diff统计信息，包括总变更文件树、总新增行、总删减行以及每个文件的新增行与删减行
name: GetMergeRequestChangeTree

parameters.help_en: The ID of the organization. Find this ID in the URL of Alibaba Cloud DevOps: `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/<organizationId>`
parameters.help_zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
parameters.name: organization_id

parameters.help_en: The personal access token. Not required if authenticating with an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair (AK/SK) or Security Token Service (STS)
parameters.help_zh:
个人访问令牌。
使用阿里云AK+SK或使用STS临时授权方式不需要传该字段
parameters.name: access_token

parameters.help_en: The ID or full path of the repository
parameters.name: repository_identity

parameters.help_en: The local ID of the merge request within its repository
parameters.help_zh: 合并请求局部ID，表示代码库下的第几个合并请求
parameters.name: local_id

parameters.help_en:
The business ID of the patch set for the merge target.

In APIs related to merge requests and comparisons, `from` and `to` may seem counterintuitive. `from` specifies the merge target, and `to` specifies the merge source. This order aligns with the execution sequence of a native Git command. The source and target labels in the UI are adjusted for clarity
parameters.help_zh:
合并目标的版本业务ID

关于from和to，在合并请求以及比较相关的接口中，from和to与常识是相反的，即 from应该是合并目标，to才是合并源，该顺序符合实际Git执行时的顺序，页面UI的源和目标实际上是经过处理后的，才会符合直觉
parameters.name: from_patch_set_biz_id

parameters.help_en:
The business ID of the patch set for the merge source.

In APIs related to merge requests and comparisons, `from` and `to` may seem counterintuitive. `from` specifies the merge target, and `to` specifies the merge source. This order aligns with the execution sequence of a native Git command. The source and target labels in the UI are adjusted for clarity
parameters.help_zh:
合并源的版本业务ID

关于from和to，在合并请求以及比较相关的接口中，from和to与常识是相反的，即 from应该是合并目标，to才是合并源，该顺序符合实际Git执行时的顺序，页面UI的源和目标实际上是经过处理后的，才会符合直觉
parameters.name: to_patch_set_biz_id
